from urllib.parse import urlparse

quantities = ["length", "mass", "time", "electric current", "thermodynamic temperature"]
single_query = "site.nist.gov SI base units length mass time electric current thermodynamic temperature"
single_hits = search(single_query, k=5)
record_discovery(single_query, quantities)
batch_queries = [
    "site.nist.gov SI base units table meter kilogram second ampere kelvin",
    "site.nist.gov international system units base units symbols"
]
batch_hits = search_many(batch_queries, k=4)
for query in batch_queries:
    record_discovery(query, [])

print("Single results:", [(h["title"], h["url"]) for h in single_hits])
print("Batched results:", [[(h["title"], h["url"]) for h in hits] for hits in batch_hits])
